explanation: OEIS A109671 (a(1) = 1, a(2n) = a(n), a(2n+1) the smallest positive number with |a(2n+1) − a(2n−1)| = a(n)): 'Does the sequence contain every positive integer?' The formal a takes a(2n−1) − a(n) when that is positive and a(2n−1) + a(n) otherwise, which is exactly the smallest positive solution; it reproduces the first 34 DATA terms. The statement 'every m > 0 equals some a(n), n > 0' is the positive form of the question. Faithful.
